_comment: Curated spin information for library structures (2026-10-21). Keys: category/file.mol2. The total charge always comes from the formal charges of the file; multiplicity here overrides the default (tmQM complexes: 1, the closed-shell tmQM reference; other molecules: 1 or 2 from the electron count). note: shown in the Structures tab.

26_cofactors_coenzymes/heme_a.mol2.note: low spin in cytochrome a (two His); high spin (5) in heme a3

26_cofactors_coenzymes/heme_b.mol2.note: high spin in deoxy globins (one His); low spin (1) with two strong axial ligands or O2/CO bound

26_cofactors_coenzymes/heme_c.mol2.note: low spin in c-type cytochromes (His/Met or His/His)

26_cofactors_coenzymes/siroheme.mol2.note: high spin without strong axial ligands; depends on the axial ligation in the enzyme

26_cofactors_coenzymes/cyanocobalamin.mo.note: low-spin Co(III); the DMB base is not bonded to Co in this file

26_cofactors_coenzymes/methylcobalamin.m.note: low-spin Co(III); the DMB base is not bonded to Co in this file

26_cofactors_coenzymes/coenzyme_f430.mol.note: square-planar Ni(II) as drawn; 3 (high spin) when six-coordinate, as in methyl-coenzyme M reductase
